strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux to Linux or Windows using unordered FakeTCP/FEC carriers plus a native standards-compliant DTLS 1.3 WBD security/session layer. Xray/VLESS/Vision/REALITY, WireGuard and Android are not part of the V2.1 product stack.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M2 native WBD DTLS 1.3 security shim on the qualified one-lane raw/FEC carrier
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Qualify the exact pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 implementation and its certificate/hostname verification path before integrating it into UDPspeeder/udp2raw. Do not add custom FEC, two lanes, kernel-anchor work, native TUN/session features, Auto, custom post-handshake crypto, or detector-specific fingerprint shaping during V2-M2.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed V2-M1 at substantive checkpoint 61037c33ed3c230486378845328e7e54a3c43ab4. The exact pinned udp2raw 20230206.0 / e5ecd33ec4c25d499a14213a5d1dbd5d21e0dd63 and UDPspeeder 20230206.0 / 61b24a369700c3d8248dd18fa9a524b778741454 amd64 binaries were SHA-256 verified and executed locally. Final qualification used classic --raw-mode faketcp with upstream -a RST-suppression rules on both client and server inside an isolated unshare -Urn network namespace. The 50 ms RTT, 200 x 256 B, window 32, three-seed 0/1/5/10/15% forward FEC-shard loss matrix covered both 20:10 and 20:20: all 30 cases completed 64/64 warmup and 200/200 delivery, all measured late>100ms ratios were zero, and median p99 remained approximately 70-78 ms. Results, receipt, report and reproducible harness were committed; deps/oracle-lock.json now marks the exact raw/FEC baseline locally qualified; temporary relay workflows were removed from the source tree.
continuation_cursor.current_task: V2-M2: add the native DTLS 1.3 security layer defined by ADR-0003, starting with exact local qualification of pinned wolfSSL v5.9.2-stable / ac01707f552c611fbd135cc723b2682b3e7f80f2 and a minimal real-certificate DTLS 1.3 client/server handshake before carrier integration.
continuation_cursor.why_now: V2-M1 has established a clean local raw/FEC latency baseline. DTLS can now be measured as an incremental security layer without confounding carrier behavior. The first M2 gate is deliberately security/correctness-only so certificate verification and DTLS 1.3 protocol use are proven before UDPspeeder/FakeTCP integration complexity is added.
continuation_cursor.done_when: V2-M2 is complete when the exact pinned wolfSSL source/build identity is recorded and locally qualified; a real DTLS 1.3 client/server handshake succeeds with an operator-style test CA/server certificate and strict expected-hostname verification; untrusted and hostname-mismatched certificates fail; UDPspeeder source/repair datagrams each traverse as DTLS application datagrams between UDPspeeder and udp2raw; loss of one DTLS application record does not block later source/repair records; and local 0/1/5/10/15% measurements record p50/p95/p99/delivery, FEC bytes, DTLS/security bytes, CPU and memory. 0-RTT stays disabled and there is no custom crypto fallback.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: V2-M2A: obtain or build the exact wolfSSL v5.9.2-stable / ac01707f552c611fbd135cc723b2682b3e7f80f2 source/build bytes, record SHA-256/build flags/toolchain, then locally run the smallest DTLS 1.3 UDP loopback client/server using a generated test CA plus a server certificate for wbd.test. Require native chain+hostname verification to pass for wbd.test and fail for a mismatched hostname and an untrusted CA. Do not insert UDPspeeder or udp2raw into the DTLS path until this gate passes.
